items.title: Endless Blading Centered Frame Locks
items.description: Endless Blading Centered Frame Locks. Endless Frame Locks are the missing link for unlocking maximum performance from your 165 mount frames. Specifically designed for the lateral mounting slots on all Endless 165 frames, patent-pending Frame Locks minimize unwanted play in the frame-to-boot bolted joint while simultaneously improving mechanical coupling between the frame and boot. This part was engineered to keep 165 frames from shifting when subjected to intense or abusive skating. If you struggle to keep your frames secured in place, or have always wished for a single, perfectly centered hole for mounting your frames, Endless Blading Centered Frame Locks are your solution. Insert these parts into the front and rear mounting slots from inside the frame, replacing standard washers. The frame mounting bolt passes through the hole in the Frame Lock. Learn more about why Frame Locks are superior to standard washers.

items.title: Playlife Khaan LTD Blue Kids Inline Skates
items.description: The Playlife Khaan LTD Blue Kids Inline Skates are not just another kids’ skate — it’s the perfect start for young adventurers ready to hit the streets in style. Designed to grow with your child and built tough for daily action, this skate combines bold looks, comfort, and performance. With its classic white base and pastel accents, and trusted construction, it’s time to roll into the season with confidence. The Playlife Khaan LTD Blue Kids Inline Skates feature a solid Unibody hardboot designed specifically for kids — robust, protective, and made for those who love to push limits. Inside, a high-cut liner delivers exceptional comfort while offering enhanced lateral support, helping kids stay upright and stable. From the very first stride to their confident turns, the boot hugs the foot securely, offering just the right blend of firmness and flexibility. Thanks to a combination of standard laces, a 45-degree ratchet buckle, and a micro-adjustable top buckle, the foot is locked in safely and precisely — no more slipping, just skating! What good is a great boot without the right wheels and bearings? The Playlife Khaan LTD Blue Kids Inline Skates deliver on all fronts with a size-adapted setup that includes durable PU wheels in 64mm, 70mm, 72mm or 76mm diameters, each with a grippy 85A hardness for the perfect balance of speed and control. The ABEC 7 bearings ensure a smooth ride, while the SCS Speed Control System gives kids the confidence to control their pace — especially when they’re just starting out. Whether cruising around the park or rolling down the driveway, every element is tuned for fun, safe learning and effortless progression. Let’s be real — kids grow fast. That’s why the Playlife Khaan LTD Blue Kids Inline Skates are size-adjustable across four sizes, making it a smart investment for parents and a reliable companion for young skaters. And if the pastel look isn’t their vibe, there’s always the Pastel option for a stronger aesthetic. This skate is more than just gear — it’s the beginning of an adventure. So why wait? Let the journey begin — one smooth, confident roll at a time.

items.description: MYFIT Cushion Pro Innersoles are designed to enhance comfort, shock absorption, and foot stability in inline skates. The MYFIT Cushion Pro Innersoles feature a low arch profile; the innersoles support a natural foot position, with medium heel and midfoot support for balanced stability and efficient power transfer. Its low-stiffness construction allows adaptive flex, making it well-suited for all kinds of skating, from fitness skating and commuting to extensive urban and park sessions where impact reduction is needed. With a focus on high comfort and reliable shock function, the Cushion Pro Innersole helps reduce fatigue and refines the overall connection between foot and skate.

items.title: Ennui ST Smiley 3 Pack Protection Set
items.description: Ennui ST Smiley 3 Pack Protection Set – Stay Safe. Stay Happy. Bright, bold, and built for action – the ENNUI Smiley Protective Gear Set brings joy to every ride while keeping young skaters confidently protected. Designed especially for kids getting into aggressive skating, this colorful set delivers high-performance protection with a look that’s all smiles. Don’t let the fun look fool you – the Ennui ST Smiley 3 Pack Protection Set means business when it comes to safety. The knee and elbow pads feature thick anatomical padding that’s shaped to fit young bodies comfortably while absorbing hard impacts like a pro. The knee pads come with a clever open-back design and winged closure system, making them easy to slip on and take off – no wrestling required. An elastic Velcro strap on top and a sturdy nylon strap with buckle underneath keep them securely in place, no matter how wild the session gets. The elbow pads feature a cozy sleeve-style construction with two elastic straps for a snug, flexible fit that stays put, even during wipeouts. Every Ennui ST Smiley 3 Pack Protection Set’s wristguard features reinforced splints on both top and bottom, giving little wrists the protection they need during falls. The tried-and-tested 3-strap closure system ensures the guards stay tight, centered, and exactly where they should be – all session long. From the breathable materials to the playful Smiley design, this set is designed to help kids feel good as they learn, fall, and try again. Available in XS, S, and M, it’s a perfect fit for beginners and young thrill-seekers alike. Because skating should feel safe and look like fun. These pads meet the EN 14120 European safety standard. The Ennui ST Smiley 3 Pack Protection Set also comes in a cool alternative: the bold and rebellious Ennui ST Pirate 3 Pack Protection Set – same protection, different attitude.

items.title: Undercover Jay Yoon 58mm 88A 92A Wheels (4 pack)
items.description: Undercover Jay Yoon 58mm 88A 92A Wheels are an aggressive inline skate wheel concept developed around functional asymmetry, allowing skaters to fine-tune grind performance and rolling behavior within a single setup. Designed for technical street and park skating, this wheel set reflects a clear understanding of how durometer placement directly affects control, durability, and consistency during grinds. The 58 mm diameter provides a compact, responsive feel that supports fast spin-up, precise foot placement, and confident lock-ins on ledges and rails. What defines the Undercover Jay Yoon 58mm 88A 92A Wheels set is the mixed hardness configuration: two wheels feature an 88A durometer for grip, vibration damping, and controlled rolling, while the two 92A wheels are intended specifically for the inside position. The harder 92A urethane significantly reduces friction against ledges and coping, helping to minimize wheelbite during grinds and maintain speed and stability when locked in. This targeted hardness placement allows skaters to push harder into grinds without unwanted drag or hang-ups, while still benefiting from the smoother ride characteristics of the softer outer wheels. Manufactured from Undercover’s high-performance polyurethane, the Undercover Jay Yoon 58mm 88A 92A Wheels offer strong abrasion resistance and consistent rebound, even under repeated impacts and lateral stress typical of aggressive skating. The core construction is optimized to support the urethane under heavy load, maintaining shape integrity and predictable performance throughout longer sessions. The Undercover Jay Yoon 58mm 88A 92A Wheels set is engineered for skaters who understand the importance of wheel positioning and want a setup that actively supports grinding technique, speed control, and durability in demanding urban environments.

items.title: Playlife Phantom 80 Black Inline Skates
items.description: Playlife Phantom 80 Black Inline Skates are your ticket into the world of urban skating – without breaking the bank. Built as an affordable entry-level skate, it still packs the performance, support, and durability that even seasoned riders demand. Slip them on, roll out the door, and the city instantly becomes your playground. The Playlife Phantom 80 Black Inline Skates use a tough hardboot shell with a replaceable liner, giving you the support and protection you want when you’re dodging obstacles or jumping curbs. Inside sits a comfy Basic Dual Fit liner that adapts to different foot shapes and sizes, so you get a secure, cushioned fit even on longer sessions. The closure system combines a micro-adjustable top buckle, a Time micro-adjustable ratchet buckle, and standard laces, letting you fine-tune the fit from toe to cuff. Crank everything down for maximum control or keep it a bit looser for a more relaxed ride – you’re always locked in with confidence. Underneath, the Playlife Phantom 80 Black Inline Skates are all about smooth, responsive fun. The strong Alu CNC frame in a compact 243mm length (4x80mm) gives you quick acceleration and super-nimble turns – perfect for weaving through traffic or playing around in tight urban spots. Playlife 80mm/85A HR wheels offer a sweet balance of grip and roll, while long-lasting Wicked ABEC7 bearings keep you rolling smoothly and efficiently. Thanks to the popular 165mm mounting standard, you can easily swap frames or upgrade your setup later, making this skate a future-proof choice as your skills progress. Black and grey with a speckled finish, the Playlife Phantom 80 Black Inline Skates keep things clean and stealthy while still standing out on the streets. It’s the skate that invites you to push a little harder, jump a little higher, and take the long way home – just because it’s more fun. Step into the Playlife Phantom 80 Black, hit the pavement, and turn every ride into a mini urban adventure.

items.description: Powerslide Combat 290mm 110 Trinity Frames. We are thrilled to introduce the all-new Powerslide Nova 290/3×110 frame. items.title: ENNUI Elite Red With Peak Helmet
items.description: ENNUI Elite Red With Peak Helmet. The ENNUI Elite Red helmet is the perfect companion when you’re going big and pushing your limits, whether you’re into inline skating, scoot riding, skateboarding, or virtually any other action sport. With the ENNUI Elite Red helmet, there is no need to compromise: it’s lightweight, low-volume, comfortable, and incredibly protective. Most helmets on the market are made of EPS foam injected into molds or formed as separate parts, then glued together with an ABS or PVC shell. The ENNUI Elite Red With Peak Helmet is completely different. It took almost three years to develop, but ENNUI developed a process known as “over-injected honeycomb skeleton”. The innovative EPS honeycomb skeleton is then over-injected with PVC. The skeleton is not only strong but also lightweight and low-volume, eliminating bulkiness while remaining safe and comfortable. Have confidence as you push your limits and give the ENNUI Elite Red Helmet a try; it complies with the European safety standard for bicycle helmets.

items.title: Ennui ST Eugen Enin Pro Combo Pads
items.description: Ennui ST Eugen Enin Pro Combo Pads. “Over the years, I tried countless variations of shin pads, sleeves, and knee pad combos but always ended up either compromising, being annoyed by them slipping off all the time, or destroying them in no time at all. Obviously, it is quite hard to find the right balance between comfort and safety protection without compromising one for the other, especially if you’re searching for something light and easy to put on. After years of testing different systems, I teamed up with Ennui to create a unique product, Ennui ST Eugen Enin Pro Combo Pads, that features all the important and critical small details that make the big difference. These Ennui ST Eugen Enin Pro Combo Pads are the ultimate knee and shin protection. Its one-piece construction eliminates any movement or slipping by having the middle strap function as the anchor point right over the calf. It also has an open construction for better ventilation, making it easier to get on and off and allowing for a more personalized fit. Now I no longer need to compromise because I have finally found the perfect balance of protection, mobility, and comfort. Its lightweight and breathable construction is crafted from perforated EVA that wraps perfectly around your leg. Additionally, the core is enhanced with a smooth lycra cover that reduces friction and allows for effortless movement under your clothing without any bulk. Now we come to my favorite part, which is also the most important feature, the SPC “Super Foam” – The Shock Protection cushion (SPC) is the heart of the Ennui ST Eugen Enin Pro Combo Pads and combines exceptional flexibility with impact resistance, allowing skaters the ability to execute tricks and maneuvers with confidence without sacrificing the ability to move freely or impact resistance. Certified by CE for safety, the Ennui ST Eugen Enin Pro Combo Pads are not just protective gear but a high-functioning protective system that is tailored to the needs of the world’s most demanding skaters seeking robust protection without the inconvenience of wearing separate bulky and slipping knee and shin guards that restrict them.

items.title: Luminous DUO LED 110mm 85A Wheels (2 PACK)
items.description: Luminous DUO LED 110mm 85A Wheels – Double the Color; Double the Light; Double the Fun! LUMINOUS DUO LED wheels bring a unique bi-color lighting system that illuminates both the hub and the urethane for a spectacular skating experience. The Luminous DUO LED 110mm 85A Wheels are the new generation of LED wheels featuring a unique dual-color lighting system. Unlike traditional LED wheels that illuminate in a single color, DUO technology uses two LED colors: one illuminating the wheel hub and another illuminating the urethane. This creates a striking bi-color lighting effect while skating. The system is powered by magnetic spacers that work like a dynamo, meaning no batteries are required. As the wheel spins, it generates the energy needed to power the LEDs. With a hardness of 85A, Luminous DUO LED 110mm 85A Wheels offer a balanced combination of speed, grip, comfort, and durability, making them suitable for both indoor and outdoor skating. Please note: These Luminous DUO LED 110mm 85A Wheels will work only with 8mm axles, so if you have a sleeve-like spacer in your wheels, you will need to add the 6mm adapters.

items.title: FR NEO 1 LZ Promodel Inline Skates
items.description: The FR NEO 1 LZ Promodel Inline Skates are the first signature skate from international skating champion, coach, and content creator Linda Zhu (@lindazhu_8). Recognized for her mastery of Slides and Skatecross/Freeride, Linda brings her extensive experience to a skate engineered for performance, stability, and expressive movement. This Promodel is both a tribute to her influence within the skating community and one of the most advanced PU/PP hard-shell all-around skates ever developed. Constructed with a single-density NEO 1 shell, the FR NEO 1 LZ Promodel Inline Skates provide enhanced support while maintaining flex patterns that allow dynamic, fluid control. The extra-padded, removable liner increases comfort and foot hold, ensuring a secure and cushioned ride during slides, urban flow, or freeride sessions. The R2 dual diameter flat frames (90-84-84-90mm) deliver a unique combination of acceleration, maneuverability, and stability. Paired with FR Downtown wheels in 85A and Twincam MW9 bearings, this setup ensures fast roll, excellent grip, and consistent performance for versatile skating styles. Like all skates in the NEO collection, the FR NEO 1 LZ Promodel Inline Skates are designed for freedom of movement, optimal comfort, and high-precision skating. Its lowered balance point, natural flex, and finely tuned shell architecture make the skate feel like a natural extension of the body. The NEO liner offers exceptional cushioning and mobility, while the 4-position cuff adjustment and double adjustable straps provide a customizable fit for different morphologies. The 5-point energy plates guarantee efficient power transfer and perfect frame alignment for stability and confidence in every stride. This FR NEO 1 LZ Promodel Inline Skates model combines technical excellence with Linda Zhu’s skating philosophy: fluidity, adaptability, and a deep connection between skater and skate.

items.title: Powerslide Elite FSK 80 Black Trinity Frames
items.description: Powerslide Elite FSK 80 Black Trinity Frames. Check out the new Powerslide Elite FSK 80 Black Trinity Frames 243 mm / 4×80 mm – designed for the city and styled for the street. Made from cast aluminum, this frame gives you the solid, secure ride you want when urban terrain gets unpredictable. It’s based on the proven Elite cast platform you already know, but the FSK version takes it up a notch: sharper lines, a more angular, urban silhouette, and a look that feels right at home in the urban jungle between concrete edges and night rides. Thanks to the patented TRINITY 3-point mounting system, you get a direct, stable connection that ensures precise control and responsive handling. And with the classic 243 mm 4×80 configuration, it hits the sweet spot for FSK skating—agile enough for quick direction changes, smooth on uneven terrain, and balanced for all-around city flow. To ensure everything fits securely and precisely, the Powerslide Elite FSK 80 Black Trinity Frames come with 8 mm hex single axles – and aluminum floating spacers and a tool are also included, so you can start assembling, tuning, and riding right away. If you’re looking for a frame that rides tough and looks even tougher, the Elite FSK is the one for you.

items.title: Powerslide Elite FSK 90 Black Trinity Frames
items.description: Powerslide Elite FSK 90 Black Trinity Frames. When Powerslide Elite frame DNA meets edgy urban look – the new Elite FSK cast aluminum frame. We present the new Powerslide Elite FSK 90 Black Trinity Frames 275 mm / 4×90 mm – the urban upgrade for skaters who want more speed, more flow, and more attitude. Made from sturdy cast aluminum, this frame provides a solid, secure feel that you can rely on even on uneven roads. It’s based on the proven DNA of the Elite cast frame, but the Elite FSK version refines everything with a more angular, street-inspired design – clean lines, bold shapes, and a look that fits right in with the city. Thanks to the TRINITY 3-point mounting system, you get a low, stable connection that improves control and ensures that every push feels direct and efficient. The 275 mm / 4×90 configuration of the Powerslide Elite FSK 90 Black Trinity Frames provides extra roll and momentum for faster cruising and smoother gliding – perfect for longer city distances, bigger transitions, and keeping your speed up in the urban maze. Of course, Powerslide Elite FSK 90 Black Trinity Frames come completely ready to assemble: 8 mm single axles with hex heads, floating aluminum spacers, and a tool are included, so you can quickly set it up and hit the streets right away. speed, urban, off-road, hockey, or even ice!

items.title: ENNUI City Sam Crofts Wristguard
items.description: ENNUI City Sam Crofts Wristguard. Ennui is proud to present the first release in a new series of pro product collaborations, the ENNUI City Sam Crofts Wristguard. Using the classic City Brace silhouette, Sam modified the design to suit his own street and bowl skating style… “I’ve been using the standard style Ennui City braces for about 10 years now, having been plagued with long-term and repeated wrist injuries. It’s easily the best wrist protection on the market, which has allowed me to continue skating the way I want, whilst safely protecting my wrists and preventing any further injuries. I fully stand behind the proven results of this product. We tested a large variety of samples when working on the design of my pro version, and I’m very happy with the final product, the ENNUI City Sam Crofts Wristguard. I first removed the corset-style lacing closure and replaced it with an extra-thick and sturdy single strap to prevent the laces from tearing on rough street spots. This oversized single strap threads through an extra reinforced metal hoop for a simple and effective closure, inspired by the popular late 90’s style guards. For extra support, I slightly increased the length of the brace, and for hygiene, I made the interior padding removable and machine washable. The entire brace is constructed in a real full-grain nubuck suede for maximum durability on abrasion, but also very importantly for increased palm grip when trying to catch yourself on a rail to save yourself or correct your balance on a fall. The unique colorway follows the classic construction/workwear-inspired aesthetic of my current pro USD Aeon.”
items.product_type: Hand and Wrist Braces > New Arrivals > Protection & Apparel > Roller Derby Skates

items.title: Iqon Decode DH Downhill Trinity Frames
items.description: Iqon Decode DH Downhill Trinity Frames. In inline downhill, everything changes depending on the track: some tracks require more slides, more turns, others more lines, and top speed. So there’s no single ideal frame. Iqon optimized and combined the four most popular setups into a single versatile frame. The Iqon Decode DH Downhill Trinity Frames are truly the Swiss Army knife of downhill inline skating. They feature versatile 4-in-1 setups: 5x90mm, 125-100-100-125mm, 125-110-110-125mm, and 4x110mm. On the Iqon Decode DH Downhill Trinity Frames, the wheels are mounted from the inside of the frame, allowing rapid wheel changes without removing skates. Critical for lightning-fast pit stops during races. With this frame, you will have no problem using any leftover downhill wheels. All setups are slightly shifted backward, offering better stability in tuck positions and smoother slide initiation. However, you have full freedom to adjust the frame position thanks to elongated mounting rails, longer than standard Trinity frames. Choose Iqon Decode DH Downhill Trinity Frames to dominate the downhill and never compromise on speed or control.

items.title: Undercover Lauric Picard 60mm 90A Wheels (4 pack)
items.description: Undercover Lauric Picard 60mm 90A Wheels are an aggressive inline skate wheel designed around a classic, all-terrain street profile, combining predictable control with durability for demanding urban skating. Developed in close alignment with Lauric Picard’s approach to technical street skating, this wheel set focuses on consistency, balance, and reliability rather than extremes, making it a versatile choice for skaters who value a composed and controlled ride. The 60 mm diameter offers a well-judged balance between roll speed and manoeuvrability. Compared to smaller setups, it provides improved carry over rougher surfaces and smoother approaches, while still remaining compact enough for precise foot control and confident grind engagement. This size is particularly well-suited to skaters who want stable landings and sustained speed without sacrificing responsiveness during technical lines. With a 90A durometer, the Undercover Lauric Picard 60mm 90A Wheels deliver a controlled blend of grip and slide, performing reliably across a wide range of street conditions. The urethane is firm enough to resist flat spotting and abrasion on concrete and ledges, yet compliant enough to absorb impacts and reduce harsh vibrations during drops and transitions. This makes the wheel equally effective for fast approaches, controlled slides, and repeated high-impact sessions. Manufactured from Undercover’s high-quality polyurethane and paired with a robust core construction, the Undercover Lauric Picard 60mm 90A Wheels maintain their shape and performance under sustained stress. The core supports even urethane wear and consistent power transfer, contributing to predictable behaviour throughout the life of the wheel. The Undercover Lauric Picard 60mm 90A Wheels are refined, aggressive wheels for skaters seeking a dependable, well-balanced setup that excels in street environments and delivers controlled performance session after session.

items.title: Summit Bladies 99 Special Edition Skiboards
items.description: Summit Bladies 99 Special Edition Skiboards. Introducing a special edition of the Summit Ecstatic 99 cm skiboards, the Bladies Cherry Blossom Skiboards – an exclusive collaboration that blends Summit’s high-performance engineering with Bladies bold, empowering style. Adorned with an elegant cherry blossom design, this skiboard embodies beauty, renewal, and new beginnings — just like the petals of spring. Whether you’re carving fresh lines through powder or pushing your limits in the park, the Cherry Blossom Skiboards deliver a ride that’s both fluid and dynamic. Summit’s popular 99cm skiboards were specially designed for the Bladies (blade ladies) community. These super energetic skiboards are designed to dominate mountain slopes, offering unparalleled versatility for skiboarders. Specifically constructed for quick, easy turns and stability at speed, the wide-body shape is equally at home on groomed runs as in the crud or floating through powder. Symmetrical twin tips of the Summit Bladies 99 Special Edition Skiboards for spinning and playing all over the mountain. Summit named these Ecstatic skiboards “Bladies” to celebrate the innovative skaters who are pushing the boundaries of skiboarding, including snow-covered cityscapes, such as downtown streets, rails, and even snow-covered skate parks, as well as all over the mountain, including groomed, off-trail, and parks! Join the movement and discover the endless possibilities that Summit Bladies 99 Special Edition Skiboards offer for both traditional and urban winter adventures! Handcrafted, one pair at a time, with extreme attention to detail, the Summit Bladies 99 Special Edition Skiboards feature a vertically laminated tip-to-tail northern birch/poplar wood core and parabolic sidecut. Cap construction is used in the front and rear for greater durability.

items.title: Kizer Edge NT 580 UFS Inline Frames
items.description: Kizer Edge NT 580 UFS Inline Frames. The EDGE NT 580 introduces a new configuration to the lineup, built with the same design principles that define the EDGE series. CNC-machined from 6061 aluminum, the frame features clean lines, consistent wall thickness, and an efficient overall structure that delivers a stable, responsive feel. The mounting slot on top is oval-shaped, allowing small front-to-back adjustments to help center the frame on different boots. The deck includes a small heel rise, offering a gentle forward bias toward the ball of the foot. The progressive rocker brings a smooth transition through every wheel, creating a natural balance between control and agility. Compared to the previously released version bundled with it, the rocker has been fine-tuned for increased manoeuvrability while retaining the same familiar overall character, a refinement of the Kizer Edge NT 580 UFS Inline Frames carried out with input from Kizer team rider Nicola Torelli. The geometry follows proven concepts from some of the most respected frames on the market, adapted to the EDGE series’ characteristics. With a UFS mount, the Kizer Edge NT 580 UFS Inline Frames sit low and centered on the boot for a direct and predictable connection. The 5×80 layout provides a long, supportive platform while maintaining the agility expected from modern urban and movement-focused skating. Single axles keep the setup simple and precise. Despite its solid construction, the Kizer Edge NT 580 UFS Inline Frames remain lighter than many comparable frames on the market.

items.title: Undercover Alu 8mm Wheel Spacers
items.description: Undercover Alu 8mm Wheel Spacers. Undercover aluminum spacers are made of 6061 aircraft aluminum. They fit all Undercover wheels and other common inline skates featuring axles with 8mm diameter and all common wheels that have a total core width of 24mm. These are replacement 8mm floating aluminum spacers that fit between the bearings in your inline wheels. Undercover Alu 8mm Wheel Spacers are universal and will work with all inline skates, roller skates, and skateboards that use 8mm axles. If you are riding a longboard or a skateboard and would like to get more speed and/or smoother rotation from your wheels, these spacers will take a load off your bearings and allow that with ease.

items.title: Ennui Street Black Dual Protection Set
items.description: The Ennui Street Black Dual Protection Set is a comprehensive protection for urban skating. Designed for urban and aggressive skaters, the Ennui Street dual set offers superior protection with a touch of style. This set is a synergy of well-engineered components, including knee pads paired with the Ennui ST wristguards, each tailored to provide the needed safety and comfort in urban skating environments. The knee pads in the Ennui Street Black Dual Protection Set feature a robust construction with high-impact foam and large, flat hard-shell caps, designed to absorb and distribute impact forces effectively. Their dual-strapping system secures the pads in place, ensuring a snug fit that doesn’t compromise mobility or comfort. The sleek, low-profile design integrates seamlessly into streetwear, perfect for skaters who prefer a discreet yet protective setup. For the outside of the pad, Ennui used denim material that gives the pads not just a cool look but also strength and durability. Adding to the Ennui Street Black Dual Protection Set, the Ennui ST wristguards are known for their ergonomic design and functionality. To protect you from wrist injuries, the ST Wristguard incorporates a durable plastic splint on the lower palm and wrist area. The wristguard includes a breathable CoolMax lining to promote ventilation and help keep your temperature down when you’re enjoying an intense skate session on a hot day. Both the knee pads and wristguards utilize breathable fabrics to keep you cool and dry, enhancing comfort during prolonged use. Whether you are skating, skateboarding, or engaging in any other high-impact street sport, the Ennui Street Black Dual Protection Set provides comprehensive protection that meets the needs of both amateurs and professionals. Opt for the Ennui Street Black Dual Protection Set for a complete protective solution that combines advanced safety technology, superior comfort, and a modern aesthetic, helping you push the boundaries safely with every ride. The Ennui Street dual set complies with the European safety standard EN 14120 and is CE-approved.

items.title: Powerslide Urban Black Matt Helmet
items.description: Powerslide Urban Black Matt Helmet. It’s back in black and here to keep you safe while you’re enjoying your favorite action sports. Whether you’re shredding the skatepark on your inline skates, bombing down a hill on your skateboard, or going big while riding your scooter, the POWERSLIDE Urban Black Matt is the helmet for you. Designed to be safe, comfortable, and reduce bulkiness, the Powerslide Urban Black Matt Helmet uses only the best components and materials, incorporating high-density EPS foam and a super-strong ABS shell to keep you safe from impacts and abrasions. Complete with an “easy clip” buckle, the Urban Black 2 helmet from POWERSLIDE stays securely on your head while still being easy to put on and take off. If you’re looking for a reliable stunt helmet to keep you safe and sound when you’re practicing your favorite action sport, give the Powerslide Urban Black Matt Helmet a try. This helmet conforms to the European safety standard for bicycle helmets.

items.title: USD Glitch Vikings On Aggressive Skates
items.description: Meet the USD Glitch Vikings On Aggressive Skates, size-adjustable signature model celebrating the fearless energy and raw talent of Thor and Astrid—siblings better known as the Vikings on Skates. This dynamic duo has been turning heads in the aggressive inline scene with their explosive style, infectious enthusiasm, and standout performances at parks and events around the world. From training at the legendary Woodward West camp to showcasing their progression across social media, Thor and Astrid embody what it means to grow with the sport. items.title: Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Bronze Frames
items.description: Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Bronze Frames. By using only the best aluminium available and the original UFS Angle design by Pieter Wijnant, Symetrics managed to create a WZRD frame that is optimal for flatland skating, also known as the Wizard skating style. The WZRD F frame is in every way unique. It features a Hi-Lo wheel setup that improves reaction time while skating and offers much-needed responsiveness, thanks to a 5-wheel frame. It also uses the space inside the frame in an optimal way by having the smaller wheels in the front and larger wheels in the back. The Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Bronze Frames have a 1-3-1 rocker combination. When the base wheels (3 middle wheels) are flat on the ground, thanks to the 80-80-84 combination in the center, the frame can turn faster. In total, the wheels used are (front to back): 80mm – 80mm – 80mm – 84mm – 84mm, with the front and rear wheels rockered. This frame also features an angled UFS. Designed originally in 2014 by Pieter Wijnant, it is a way to create a more playful UFS frame with a flat boot design. Pieter has studied and designed the Symetrics frames to create the right angle for orthopedic comfort and performance. The UFS mount on the Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Bronze Frames is made with a longer slot, so it can be perfectly centered or more toe or heel based. By using closed-wall construction on the Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Bronze Frames with the Symetrics angled cutouts at the bottom and CNC-machined from a billet block of 7075 aluminium (the highest grade in the industry), Symetrics created a unique sound and feel to the frame. Not just a copycat, based on Symetrics values. Simply performance.

These wheels are paired with fast and durable Wicked ABEC 9 bearings.

items.description: MYFIT 2nd Skin Nick Lomax Pro Skate Liners. The MYFIT 2nd Skin Pro Lomax liner is perfectly shaped for boots with narrower shells that leave less room for padding. Nick’s new liner with added details stands out with its new colorway, making your skates look brand new. It´s also a great choice for skaters with wider feet who’d like to use a normal shell without any pressure points or pain. MYFIT 2nd Skin Nick Lomax Pro Skate Liners are a great way to downsize the shell size of your skates. All the MYFIT liners feel great from the very first moment you put them on, thanks to MyFit 3D anatomically shaped padding made out of a combination of various layers of high-end foam materials with different thicknesses and densities, offering the same great comfort and performance day after day. The toe box features a stretchable SBR material that covers two sizes. The tongue of the liner is made of pre-shaped and molded EVA foam. The MYFIT 2nd Skin Nick Lomax Pro Skate Liners provide full control, a super snug fit, and great comfort. The heel area is fully heat moldable and allows you to customize the fit again and again. The 2nd Skin liner includes the “custom heel fit”, a molded EVA foam to optimize heel lock. The lacing on the 2nd Skin liner adds extra stability and fixation for maximum control and performance. The lace loops on the liner give two options: to lace just the liner or to connect the shell and liner to further improve the heel lock.

The POWERSLIDE Grave Digger 200 frameset is a nearly indestructible off-road inline skating frame and wheel combo that’s designed to let you experience everything the great outdoors has to offer. Designed to be lightweight and incredibly durable, the POWERSLIDE Grave Digger 200 frame is constructed of high-grade aircraft aluminum. Made out of a single piece of aluminum, the Powerslide Grave Digger 200 Trinity Rollerski Frames Set sets a standard for precision among off-road inline skate frames. The POWERSLIDE Grave Digger 200 incorporates the TRINITY 3-point mounting system that brings the wheels close to the boot to give you a low center of gravity and unmatched stability – ideal for unpredictable off-road terrain. Able to roll over sticks, gravel, and other off-road terrains, the Powerslide Grave Digger 200 Trinity Rollerski Frames Set comes equipped with durable 8″ / 200mm tires and two-piece rims that are made of high-grade aluminum. And, to complete this superb off-road package, this frameset comes with Wicked Extreme 6001 bearings.

items.title: Kizer Suspension Skeleton UFS White Frames
items.description: Kizer Suspension Skeleton UFS White Frames. Suspension frames help cushion impacts and vibrations from rough surfaces. Kizer’s all-new Suspension Skeleton SuperFluid frame allows skaters to roll on a wide range of wheel setups, making it easy to find the perfect setup to complement your individual skating style. From flat to anti-rocker setups, the Suspension Kizer Suspension Skeleton Superfluid UFS Frames incorporate a strong fixed single lock steel axle for fast wheel rotations, while the interchangeable frame rocker spacers allow skaters to move the wheels up or down a full 3mm. Made of the revolutionary SuperFluid material, the Kizer Suspension Skeleton UFS White Frames are nearly indestructible while sliding smoothly and fast on all sorts of surfaces. This innovative frame also incorporates a central groove shape that virtually eliminates wheel bite. At only 235g (size small) per frame, the Kizer Suspension Skeleton SuperFluid frame is incredibly lightweight. It’s also designed around the popular UFS mounting system, allowing skaters to attach the frame to an extensive selection of boots. Designed by Layon Chang / BRA Back in the year 2000, Kizer’s famous Fluid material was introduced to the aggressive skating world. Fluid quickly earned a reputation for being nearly indestructible while delivering fast, smooth grinds on almost any surface. SuperFluid is the evolutionary next step, improving on the original Fluid material and proving that you can make a good thing even better. SuperFluid material is harder, stiffer, and now even longer-lasting, giving skaters unmatched grinding performance. Kizer’s new Superfluid material is made of a special Nylon combined with a high percentage of carbon fiber, which, when combined, makes the material rock hard and a pleasure to use. Although SuperFluid frames can have a higher upfront cost than other products, they are often a better value. Kizer Suspension Skeleton UFS White Frames last longer, so you replace frames less often, saving you money in the long run and reducing waste from throw-away frames. Give Kizer’s new SuperFluid material a try and enjoy a truly unequaled grinding experience that will put a smile on your face.

items.title: Ennui Shock Sleeve Pro Knee Gaskets II
items.description: Ennui Shock Sleeve Pro Knee Gaskets II – lightweight and unobtrusive protection. The Ennui Shock Sleeve Pro knee gasket is specifically engineered for athletes requiring lightweight, unobtrusive knee protection, optimized for both comfort and flexibility. This latest iteration of the Shock Sleeve Pro introduces key material and design updates that elevate its performance and user experience. The gasket is constructed from high-quality knitted cotton, chosen for its breathability and natural stretchability. This material provides a comfortable, snug fit that molds to the shape of the knee, ensuring that the gasket moves seamlessly with the athlete’s motions. Knitted cotton is also renowned for its soft texture, enhancing wearer comfort during prolonged use. The Ennui Shock Sleeve Pro Knee Gaskets II comes with our “super foam” – the MYFIT SPC (Shock Protection Cushion) pads covered by Kevlar material. Kevlar is known for its exceptional strength and resistance to abrasion. An update in this model is the introduction of an extra elastic V-Power Strap at the top of the sleeve. This, in combination with silicone prints placed on the top and bottom inside of the sleeve, guarantees a secure fit, preventing the gasket from slipping during rigorous movements and ensuring that the protective padding remains optimally aligned over the knee at all times. With its CE certification, the Ennui Shock Sleeve Pro Knee Gaskets II adheres to stringent European safety standards, affirming its quality and reliability as protective gear.

items.title: Kizer Suspension Skeleton UFS Black Frames
items.description: Kizer Suspension Skeleton UFS Black Frames. Suspension frames help cushion impacts and vibrations from rough surfaces. Kizer’s all-new Suspension Skeleton SuperFluid frame allows skaters to roll on a wide range of wheel setups, making it easy to find the perfect setup to complement your individual skating style. From flat to anti-rocker setups, the Suspension Kizer Suspension Skeleton Superfluid UFS Frames incorporate a strong fixed single lock steel axle for fast wheel rotations, while the interchangeable frame rocker spacers allow skaters to move the wheels up or down a full 3mm. Made of the revolutionary SuperFluid material, the Kizer Suspension Skeleton UFS Black Frames are nearly indestructible while sliding smoothly and fast on all sorts of surfaces. This innovative frame also incorporates a central groove shape that virtually eliminates wheel bite. At only 235g (size small) per frame, the Kizer Suspension Skeleton SuperFluid frame is incredibly lightweight. It’s also designed around the popular UFS mounting system, allowing skaters to attach the frame to an extensive selection of boots. Designed by Layon Chang / BRA Back in the year 2000, Kizer’s famous Fluid material was introduced to the aggressive skating world. Fluid quickly earned a reputation for being nearly indestructible while delivering fast, smooth grinds on almost any surface. SuperFluid is the evolutionary next step, improving on the original Fluid material and proving that you can make a good thing even better. SuperFluid material is harder, stiffer, and now even longer-lasting, giving skaters unmatched grinding performance. Kizer’s new Superfluid material is made of a special Nylon combined with a high percentage of carbon fiber, which, when combined, makes the material rock hard and a pleasure to use. Although SuperFluid frames can have a higher upfront cost than other products, they are often a better value. Kizer Suspension Skeleton UFS Black Frames last longer, so you replace frames less often, saving you money in the long run and reducing waste from throw-away frames. Give Kizer’s new SuperFluid material a try and enjoy a truly unequaled grinding experience that will put a smile on your face.

items.title: Chaya Pro Roller Skate Backpack
items.description: The Chaya Pro Roller Skate Backpack is the second generation of the Chaya Pro Backpack emerges as probably the smartest roller skate backpack out there. This backpack is stuffed with cool features and is designed not just to carry your gear but to enhance the overall mobility and convenience. Let’s start with the basics. The base of the backpack is the first generation. We kept the size with a volume of approx. 52 liters, which offers enough space for all your personal belongings. This is the only thing the old and new generations have in common. The backpack has been reworked in total for better comfort and functionality. A novel feature of the Chaya Pro Roller Skate Backpack is its newly developed shoulder strap construction. These padded shoulder straps are now closer to each other for supreme wear comfort, using advanced ergonomics to ensure weight is distributed evenly, thereby reducing fatigue and increasing wearability during extended use. The padded hip belt also distributes the load, so that even a heavily loaded backpack can be carried effortlessly. Want to give your shoulders a break from a heavy backpack? Let your backpack rest on top of your trolley bag, thanks to the strap on the back. Skate fixation is integrated on both sides of the backpack. Two adjustable clip straps on each side of the bag keep your skates securely in place. Complete with ingenious zip-hidden wheel covers that prevent your clothes from getting dirty. For tech-savvy skaters, the Chaya Pro offers a dedicated zippered and padded compartment on the backside, designed to safeguard electronics and other valuable items securely and conveniently. The strategic placement ensures that valuable items remain protected and accessible without compromising on comfort. The backpack’s versatility is further enhanced by a detachable front bag, featuring its own shoulder straps that can be clipped to the bag for independent use. This front bag features an RFID-protected compartment, providing peace of mind for those carrying sensitive personal items, making it ideal for travel and daily commutes. Adding to its comprehensive features, the Chaya Pro Roller Skate Backpack includes a removable helmet net at the front of the bag. The bottom compartment is now firmly connected to the main compartment and features air ventilation, perfect for storing worn gear or shoes. An integrated zipped rain cover has been added to protect the backpack against the elements. Reflective pipings and prints on the backpack increases visibility, enhancing safety for night-time activities, a thoughtful addition for those who skate after dark. With its combination of comfort, security, and additional smart features, the Chaya Pro Roller Skate Backpack is truly a standout, designed to meet and exceed the demands of modern skaters who require functionality and style in every element of their gear.

items.description: Summit Urban 99cm Skiboards Salomon M11 24/25. Introducing the all-new Summit Urban 99 cm skiboards, created to revolutionize your winter experience! These super energetic skiboards are made for quick, easy turns, and stability at speed, with symmetrical twin tips for spinning and playing on the mountain.

items.title: Summit Easy Rider 79cm Skiboards 25/26
items.description: Summit Easy Rider 79cm Skiboards. So easy to ride, so effortless, you will truly enjoy it. As the name implies, these skiboards make it easy to have a super fun, easy time riding the ski slopes from the first day. With a super short learning curve, you can just focus on having fun. With their high-quality construction, you can still cruise like on longer skiboards, riding any terrain you care to. If anything could be called an “easy ski,” this is it! Featuring the same construction as Summit’s more advanced skiboards, with a tip-to-tail Northern birch wood core, Rockwell carbon steel full-wrap edges, sintered bases, and triaxial layered fiberglass, along with asymmetrical twin tips, these are very durable and have a really fast turn radius. The parabolic sidecut makes it easy to enjoy those effortless carves and parallel turns. Adults and older kids can use these to not only learn but also quickly progress to more advanced terrain. These Summit Easy Rider 79cm Skiboards deliver a super easy transition for those who want that skate-like feel on the snow as well. Don’t let the size fool you, these Summit Easy Rider 79cm Skiboards are fun to ride for any size rider and will change your whole attitude towards snowriding. These also work great for younger riders who need something a little more advanced than our Elan Kid’s skiboards. And, for those who want to do couples dancing on the slopes, these are the ticket!

items.description: Summit Invertigo 118cm Rocker Camber Skiboards feature a unique combination of 15% Rocker front tip, 80% traditional camber, and 5% rocker tail. This means riding through soft snow, and powder is an almost effortless ride, feeling more like surfing! This unique combination of rocker tips and tails with traditional camber underfoot delivers super-fast turn initiation and a short turning radius, yet offers amazing edge grip on hard pack and ice. This combination also gives you multiple sweet spots to explore throughout the length of the skiboards for endless playtime! This is the original “One Skiboard Does It All Design”. These Summit Invertigo 118cm Rocker Camber Skiboards are equally at home on hard pack/ice, moguls, glades, cruising the groomed runs, terrain parks, and, yes, floating through powder with ease. The Summit Invertigo 118cm Rocker Camber Skiboards are designed to be the ultimate “fun” skiboard. Though 118 cm in length, these have the feel of something much shorter, more like a 99 cm in how fast they turn. Yet these ride like skis with the speed to match. The Summit Invertigo 118cm Rocker Camber Skiboards are true all-mountain, all-condition skiboards. AND if you’re lucky enough to get those perfect blue sky days with untracked powder, OMG, these are the ones you want to be riding (well, that or the Summit GroovN 106 Rocker/Camber)!! Symmetrical twin tips make it easy to ride forwards and backwards.

items.title: USD Transformer Adjustable Aggressive Kids Skates
items.description: USD Transformer Adjustable Aggressive Kids Skates. Grinds, jumps, slides… aggressive inline skating is challenging, intense, and always a lot of fun – no wonder kids love it! items.title: Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Black Frames
items.description: Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Black Frames. By using only the best aluminium available and the original UFS Angle design by Pieter Wijnant, Symetrics managed to create a WZRD frame that is optimal for flatland skating, also known as the Wizard skating style. The WZRD F frame is in every way unique. It features a Hi-Lo wheel setup that improves reaction time while skating and offers much-needed responsiveness, thanks to a 5-wheel frame. It also uses the space inside the frame in an optimal way by having the smaller wheels in the front and larger wheels in the back. The Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Black Frames have a 1-3-1 rocker combination. When the base wheels (3 middle wheels) are flat on the ground, thanks to the 80-80-84 combination in the center, the frame can turn faster. In total, the wheels used are (front to back): 80mm – 80mm – 80mm – 84mm – 84mm, with the front and rear wheels rockered. This frame also features an angled UFS. Designed originally in 2014 by Pieter Wijnant, it is a way to create a more playful UFS frame with a flat boot design. Pieter has studied and designed the Symetrics frames to create the right angle for orthopedic comfort and performance. The UFS mount on the Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Black Frames is made with a longer slot, so it can be perfectly centered or more toe or heel based. By using closed-wall construction on the Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Black Frames with the Symetrics angled cutouts at the bottom and CNC-machined from a billet block of 7075 aluminium (the highest grade in the industry), Symetrics created a unique sound and feel to the frame. Not just a copycat, based on Symetrics values. Simply performance.

items.title: Symetrics Superfast 100mm 90A Wheels (2 pack)

In the end, they decided to create their own mold and urethane since none of the wheel companies provided what we needed. Wanting to offer a completely blacked-out skate, Adapt always wanted a black wheel with the performance of a pure white wheel. To achieve this goal, Adapt went with the highest quality compound possible. It’s the first PURE black wheel on the current market to give both speed and grip as well as a long-lasting lifespan. Its name? The Symetrics Superfast

items.title: Powerslide NEXT Core 90 Inline Skates
items.description: Powerslide NEXT Core 90 Inline Skates is the latest member of the NEXT family of urban inline skates. It’s a fast, fun, and versatile addition to the popular NEXT line of urban inline skates. With four 90mm wheels, it’s the perfect mixture of speed, agility, and stability. The durable boot can take on virtually anything you can throw at it, even during the most intense skating sessions – so skate, slide, jump, and discover what you’re really capable of on inline skates because the NEXT Core Black 90 can do it all. The Powerslide NEXT Core 90 Inline Skates are a great option for skaters of all levels. Ready to perform, this is a high-quality skate that’s packed with innovative features, all designed to augment your skating performance. The durable NEXT boot is complemented with a height-adjustable cuff that allows you to adjust support and forward flex to match your individual needs and skating style. The Kizer Clipper buckle has eight clips to help ensure you’re safely locked into the boot whether you’re cruising, turning, or even during the occasional fall. The Clipper buckle is complemented with a velcro 45-degree strap along with a traditional lacing system so you can customize the fit and tightness of your skates to suit your preferences and match your individual skating style. The Elite cast frame is lightweight and durable, so you can have confidence when you’re pushing your limits in the urban jungle. Engineered around the famous TRINITY 3-point mounting system, the NEXT Core Black 90 delivers superb speed, agility, and stability. With three points of contact to the boot, the TRINITY system creates a channel that brings your wheels as close to your foot as possible which gives skaters incredibly efficient power transfer while improving balance and overall control. The Powerslide NEXT Core 90 Inline Skates are a versatile skate that’s ready to impress right out of the box. Incorporating Powerslide Spinner 90mm/88A wheels that are both grippy, fast and durable, matched with super smooth WICKED ABEC 9 bearings, you’re going to have a blast cruising the city.

items.title: Powerslide NEXT Miriam Fatmi Pro 100 Inline Skates
items.description: Powerslide NEXT Miriam Fatmi Pro 100 Inline Skates. With “the one and only” Miriam Fatmi (Miri), Powerslide is proud to support one of the most versatile female inline skaters in the sport. The NEXT Miriam Fatmi Pro is a high-performance urban inline skate that’s the perfect option for female inline skaters looking for a comfortable and fast inline skating experience. The classic white base with flashy highlights gives the skate a touch of glam that definitely will turn heads. The famous NEXT is a popular hard boot skate that’s durable and supportive, making it a great option for intense urban skating. The Powerslide NEXT Miriam Fatmi Pro 100 Inline Skates have a height-adjustable cuff that makes it easy to adjust the level of ankle support to meet your individual preferences and skating style. Along with a height-adjustable cuff, the NEXT offers several other custom options including the ability to adjust the flex and closure system to optimize your skating performance. The heat moldable MYFIT Skinny Boy dual-fit liner features a ventilated PU tongue that provides the excellent fit and comfort you need for a day full of rolling fun. The NEXT is designed around the famous TRINITY mounting system that creates a channel that brings your wheels as close to the foot as possible, improving stability and control, especially if you are into tricks, jumps, and slides. The 3-point mounting also improves the power transfer to unleash your full potential. The Powerslide NEXT Miriam Fatmi Pro 100 Inline Skates include the strong, precise Nova frame made of lightweight 6061 aluminum alloy. A superb frame for urban skating, the Nova frame is designed to take on the most intense urban skating conditions. Whether you’re skating fast, sliding far, or jumping high, the Nova frame can do it all. The 260mm and 290mm (in larger sizes) frames are made for a maximum 3x110mm wheels but Miri prefers to skate with 100mm wheels. The frame gives you the possibility to upgrade your skate with bigger and faster 110mm wheels. The NEXT Miriam Fatmi Pro skates come complete with fast and durable 100mm/88a Spinner wheels and smooth-rolling WICKED ABEC 9 bearings for a fast, fun skating experience.

items.title: Powerslide Next Black Inline Skate Boots
items.description: Powerslide Next Black Inline Skate Boots. Say hello to the POWERSLIDE Next Black inline skate boot. It’s a sophisticated urban inline skate boot, offering a range of customizable options for you to make the skate your very own. At its base is a durable hardboot shell with a supportive, customizable cuff. The cuff flap can be trimmed to adjust forward flexibility, while the height of the cuff can be adjusted to allow for the perfect amount of support and lateral flexibility. The POWERSLIDE Next Black boot comes with MYFIT RECALL dual fit liner. The RECALL memory padding offers a snug and comfortable fit right out of the box. The MYFIT RECALL liner is heat-moldable, so you can further personalize the fit of your skate. The sophisticated closure system includes traditional lacing combined with a 45-degree ratchet strat to keep your foot firmly in place. POWERSLIDE makes it easy to customize the Next Black to suit your needs and unique inline skating style. It’s a high-quality hardboot with the patented TRINITY 3-point mounting system, providing a low center of gravity and unmatched control while allowing you to ride on a range of frames and wheel options. And, with X-slot mounting you can adjust the frame position under your boot to suit your exact preferences. Go off-road and hit the trails on an SUV frame set-up, explore the city in your urban freeride set-up, or roll along your favorite pathway on a 3-wheel cruising set-up, or even throw on an ice skating frame – with one boot, you can do it all with the POWERSLIDE Next Black boot.

items.title: Powerslide Storm Black 110 Inline Skates
items.description: Powerslide Storm Black 110 Inline Skates are the new urban big wheel skate with 165mm standard mounting. Are you ready for some intense big-wheel action? Powerslide has released an all-new urban hard boot skate: the Storm. Engineered around the popular 165mm mounting standard like the legendary Imperial boot, the Storm has a wider all-around fit giving the foot space to move, and is suitable also for skaters with wider feet in the toe or heel regions. The base of the Powerslide Storm Black 110 hardboot is sleek and durable – ready for fast and intense urban skating action. The boot offers skaters a wider fit compared to many other boots on the market. Ideal for big wheel urban skating, the Storm Black 110 is strong and supportive and comes with a height-adjustable cuff. The hardboot is complemented by an MYFIT Fat Boy dual-fit liner featuring anatomical padding which ensures a snug and comfortable fit every time. The Powerslide Storm Black 110 Inline Skates are paired with the sturdy Surface aluminum frame, a 2-in-1 frame allowing skaters to roll on a 4x80mm or 3x110mm wheel setup. The skate comes with fast and responsive Powerslide Spinner 110mm/88A wheels rolling on super smooth Wicked ABEC 9 bearings. The Powerslide Storm Black 110 is wide-boot skate ready for fast and fun big wheel urban inline skating.

items.title: Powerslide Next Core 100 Inline Skates
items.description: Powerslide Next Core 100 Inline Skates are the full package – you get the speed and agility of a 3-wheel urban skate and the 100mm wheels are perfect for cruising the city, sliding, and jumping with complete control and confidence. The durable hardboot skate can take a beating while the cozy liner and adjustable cuff allow you to skate all day long in comfort. These skates have everything you need for intense skating adventures. The durable NEXT boot is complemented with a height-adjustable cuff that allows you to adjust support and forward flex to match your individual needs and skating style. The Kizer Clipper buckle helps ensure you’re safely locked into the boot whether you’re cruising, turning, or even during the occasional fall. On top of the Clipper buckle, the Powerslide Next Core 100 Inline Skates have a velcro 45-degree strap along with a traditional lacing system so you can customize the fit and tightness of your skates to suit your preferences and match your individual skating style. The Elite cast frame is lightweight and durable, so you can have confidence when you’re cruising through the city, sliding, jumping stairs, or attempting a brand new trick you haven’t tried before. Engineered around the famous TRINITY 3-point mounting system, the NEXT Core Black 100 delivers superb speed, agility, and stability. With three points of contact to the boot, the TRINITY system creates a channel that brings your wheels as close to your foot as possible which gives skaters incredibly efficient power transfer while improving balance and overall control. The NEXT Core Black 100 is a versatile skate that’s ready to impress right out of the box. Incorporating Powerslide Spinner 100mm/88A wheels that are grippy, fast and durable, matched with super smooth WICKED ABEC 9 bearings, you’re going to have a blast cruising the city on this superb 3-wheel urban skate

items.title: Chaya Ragnaroll Pro 60mm 101A Roller Skate Wheels
items.description: Chaya Ragnaroll Pro 60mm 101A Roller Skate Wheels are the first quad wheels specially designed for roller skating bowls. When you look at the wheels market, most of the options came from skateboard companies or from roller skate brands selling wheels with shapes made for skateboarding. While these wheels are good for some uses and work great in sidestance skating, They always felt they are too wide to carve bowls on a parallel stance with the edges of the wheels catching against the ramps. Chaya wanted to create a wheel that gives that extra speed you need on big bowls but at the same time remains agile to cut corners and roll over hips without any dragging. Chaya Ragnaroll Pro 60mm 101A Roller Skate Wheels are 60mm 101A with a super slim shape and a roll patch of only 18mm providing high speed but great maneuverability thanks to its narrow profile and rounded lip it feels like a much smaller wheel on slides reducing dramatically any wheel bite and giving you extra space between your trucks for technical grinds. Despite its big size the reduced amount of urethane results in one of the lightest wheels on the market with only 68gr it’s 25% lighter than other wheels of the same size. The wheels come with treated lines on the rolling patch to give extra grip on slippery surfaces. “I was looking for a faster wheel to skate bowls, but I ended with the perfect all-round wheel. I feel I am rolling faster on skateparks but thanks to the narrow profile I can still do all the technical grind tricks on the street and still use it to go from spot to spot without suffering the awful roll and noise of small wheels. Not only the performance is good, but I was hoping for a fairly priced wheel with a clean and timeless design to match any style. I couldn’t be happier with the result!” Text by Ragnaroll

items.description: CHAYA Melrose Deluxe NO WAR Roller Skates. Roller skating is more than a sport; it’s an experience that brings people together to express themselves and embrace the act of rolling. CHAYA has always stood for peace and togetherness; there is no place for war and conflict in this world. In Ukraine and in Russia, we have customers, support skaters, and maintain friendships with people of all cultures, races, and creeds. We, like countless other people, are shocked by the senseless war happening right now in Ukraine, and we need to do something to help the people suffering from the Russian invasion. As a roller skate company, the best way for us to make a statement and support the people affected by this needless war is to release a skate. With CHAYA Melrose Deluxe NO WAR Roller Skates, CHAYA will donate 100% of sales to non-profit charity organizations directly involved with helping the people of Ukraine. Chaya will split the funds between these two charity organizations: Ukrainian Medical Association in Germany e.V. https://www.uaevd.de/ Intended use: Medical aid for soldiers and civilian National Bank of Ukraine: Humanity Fonds https://bank.gov.ua/en/news/all/natsionalniy-bank-vidkriv-rahunok-dlya-gumanitarnoyi-dopomogi-ukrayintsyam-postrajdalim-vid-rosiyskoyi-agresiyi Intended use: Food, shelter, clothing. Chaya has released 500 pairs of special Melrose Deluxe NO WAR skates! Our sincere appreciation goes out to the suppliers who have shown solidarity by providing the parts for the CHAYA Deluxe NO WAR skate at the lowest costs possible, illustrating that together we can make a difference and support the people who need it most. We also want to thank you, the skaters, for your support by purchasing this skate! By working together, peace can prevail, and we will make a difference. All our thoughts, prayers, and support go to the people who are suffering right now. War has no place in this world. PEACE.

items.title: Symetrics Quattro S 84-90 Frames
items.description: Symetrics Quattro S 84-90 Frames are designed for freeskating and city skating, and are one of the most versatile frames. The S stands for Speed. The Quattro S 84/90 frames have a Hi-Lo wheel configuration and can only be mounted using our unique QUATTRO mount (outer bolts). Symetrics is proud to have created the strongest mounting known to date for any inline skate together with the Adapt Brand. Using 7075 Swiss billet aluminium for their frames and by having our outer mounting design, the Quattro frame is the most rigidly mounted frame on the market. The smaller front wheels provide optimal maneuverability, while the larger rear wheels provide a faster ride. Attention: this is not a rockered frame, but it does create a feel of higher maneuverability than standard 4 down frames. Unlike regular frames, the Symetrics Quattro S 84-90 Frames are mounted on the outside of the frame, using 4 M6 stainless steel bolts, which, like the frame, are designed and manufactured in-house. This mounting method greatly improves power transfer and the frame’s overall strength. The frame does not flex under the boot as frames mounted with 2 or 3 bolts do. Symetrics Quattro S 84-90 Frames are fully made in the Netherlands and designed by Pieter Wijnant. This frame is the next level when it comes to skating. Every frame is CNC-machined to perfection and anodized for a perfect finish. The graphics are laser burned into the frame. Symetrics frames are made in-house and are a product of the Netherlands.

items.title: BONES Hardcore Soft Skateboard Bushing
items.description: BONES Hardcore Soft Skateboard Bushing. When you turn a normal truck, the hanger web puts pressure on one side of each bushing (top and bottom). This squeezes that side and pushes the other side of each bushing away from the kingpin. We call this a single-action bushing because only one side of the bushing works for you at a time. The HardCore insert in the center of BONES bushings connects the two sides of each bushing together by bonding them to the HardCore insert. When the hanger web squeezes one side of a HardCore bushing, that side of the bushing reacts just like a normal bushing, but the chemical bond between the HardCore and the cushion keeps the bushing from being squeezed out the other side. It actually increases the resistance to turning because it is held in place by the HardCore insert. This means basically that BOTH sides of the BONES HardCore Bushing are resisting your turning force. That’s why BONES calls BONES Hardcore Soft Skateboard Bushing the first double-action truck bushings.

items.title: MYFIT Crown II Liners
items.description: MYFIT Crown II Liners. The MYFIT Crown II Liner, developed in collaboration with MYFIT and USD riders, such as Chris Famer and others, sets a new benchmark in liner technology. The liner’s shape is easily customizable to your feet through its heat-moldable function, eliminating pressure points. The MYFIT Crown II Liners lacing system enhances stability and heel lock, ensuring maximum control and performance. The lace loops offer two lacing options: lacing just the liner or connecting both the shell and liner for increased heel lock. The MYFIT Crown II Liners also feature an effective and detachable shock absorber, ideal for skaters who enjoy high-impact activities. In summary, the MYFIT Crown II Liners are a top-tier choice for all wider-fitting hardshell skates with room for a thicker liner, including Razor skates, USD Aeons, USD VII, and USD Sway skates.

The higher the number, for example, ABEC 7, the less the tolerance in the bearing. Having smaller tolerances means that your bearing will spin faster, for longer.

items.title: Powerslide EGO Smart 3 x 100 Trinity Frames

TRINITY also reduces fatigue in your muscles for more pleasure on long-distance skate tours. Ego frames are crafted from 6061 aircraft aluminum, extruded and CNC machined including an unobtrusive laser print. TRINITY also offers the well-known X-slot mounting system which allows you to customize your boot-frame position by shifting the frame both side to side plus forwards and backward. It isn’t just the best-performing mounting system for inline skates, it’s also compatible with ALL frames across our range, so with a single Powerslide TRINITY mounting boot you can enjoy all segments of skating at any time. Simply change the frames and you´re ready for anything – fitness, speed, urban, off-road, hockey, or even ice. This compact all-around frame is perfectly suited for those looking for a short and agile but at the same time lightweight and fast frame to explore the city, cruise around as well as do some workout or play hockey.

items.title: ENNUI Elite White With Peak Helmet
items.description: ENNUI Elite White With Peak Helmet. After nearly 3 years of development, ENNUI released this helmet, and it has completely revolutionized what action sports helmets can be. Low-volume, lightweight, stylish, and incredibly protective – this just may be the ultimate stunt helmet on the market. While most other helmets are constructed out of EPS foam injected in molds or separate parts and then glued together with an ABS or PVC shell, the ENNUI Elite White helmet is manufactured in a unique process called “over-injected honeycomb skeleton”. The innovative EPS honeycomb skeleton is then over-injected with PVC. This manufacturing process offers a range of benefits without losing any protective properties. The honeycomb skeleton allows the helmet to be incredibly low volume, eliminating bulkiness and providing the perfect fit every time. The helmet even comes with an easily removable peak to prevent glare on those lovely sunny days. If you’re looking for the ideal helmet for action sports like inline skating, skateboarding, scooter riding, and other sports, the ENNUI Elite White is the right helmet for you. The helmet conforms with the European safety standard for bicycle helmets.

items.title: Fischer SCS Skate IFP Cross Country Skis
items.description: Fischer SCS Skate IFP Cross Country Skis. While not a race ski, skiers will enjoy the high-performance aspects without the incredibly high price tag. If you’re looking for a lightweight and easy-to-use setup, look no further than the Fischer SCS Skate skis. Featuring an Air Core Basalite Core, the skis have a super light and solid center. The Basalite is damp and light, and will greatly increase the amount of enjoyment you have out there on the trails. When you head out first thing in the morning and click into your gear, the lack of bulk and ease of use will jump out right away. The Integrated Fixation Plate (IFP) allows the skis to flex naturally and the bindings to slide up or down on the ski and changes how they perform. As a result, you can move the bindings forward for more control or backward for more glide. All of this can be done without a key, so at any point in your ski, feel free to change it up. These TRINITY frames are crafted from the highest quality aluminum, perfectly shaped, and constructed with the lowest center of gravity in mind. These Powerslide Elite Casted AL 80 Black Trinity Frames, with their 3-point mounting system, are a quantum leap in performance. Designed around the ergonomics of the wheels to provide the best stability, improved balance, reduced vibrations, and maximize the power transfer in every stride. The convenient single-axle system on the Powerslide Elite Casted AL 80 Black Trinity Frames enables fast, simple wheel maintenance. TRINITY also offers the well-known X-slot mounting system, which allows you to customize your boot-frame position by shifting the frame both side to side plus forwards and backward. TRINITY isn’t just the best-performing mounting system for inline skates; it is also compatible with ALL models across the Powerslide range, so with a single Powerslide Trinity mounting boot, you can enjoy all segments of skating at any time. Simply change the frames, and you’re ready for anything – fitness, speed, urban, off-road, hockey, or even ice!

items.title: Powerslide HC Hardcore Evo Pro Carbon Boots
items.description: Create your perfect urban skate and discover what you’re capable of on an inline skate with the Powerslide HC Hardcore Evo Pro Carbon Boots. What began as a legendary inline urban freeskate, the HC Evo Pro is now available in a boot-only option that allows you to take advantage of all the benefits of this high-performance freeskate and turn it into the ideal skate for your individual skating style. To give you perfect support, the Powerslide HC Hardcore Evo Pro Carbon Boots feature new wires in the upper, coated with strong, durable TPU. A stiff outer shell with a soft, padded interior makes this boot the pinnacle of inline urban freeskate boots on the market. The POWERSLIDE HC Evo Pro Boot is engineered with the versatile TRINITY 3-point mounting system, allowing you to mount a range of frames, from SUV off-road frames to urban frames and everything in between. POWERSLIDE offers a wide range of frames with different wheel configurations, so why not create the perfect skate just for you? Thrilling SUV skating action, long rides for your daily workout, an agile commuter skate to explore the city, or shredding some rails and curbs – everything is possible with those Powerslide HC Hardcore Evo Pro Carbon Boots from POWERSLIDE.

items.title: CHAYA Ruby Roller Derby Quad Skates
items.description: CHAYA Ruby Roller Derby Quad Skates are the most ´derby-ready´ beginner package on the market. Made of glass-fiber reinforced plastic (GFK) and including a torsion bar – a bridge to help combat improper flexing, it provides crucial stiffness to the bottom of your skates. The stylish design gives CHAYA Ruby Roller Derby Quad Skates a high-end look, and this skate offers much more than you would expect for the price. Chaya glass-fiber-reinforced Shari plate offers unique features such as the offset Chaya Controller stopper, the Power Toe System (PTS) for improved power transfer, and Jelly Interlock Cushions, which guarantee perfect handling. Derby-specific OCTO Propel 59mmx38mm / 92A PU-wheels and WICKED ABEC 7 freespin bearings mean no immediate upgrades are needed with this package; you have it all from the very beginning!

items.title: Powerslide Combat Rocker 260mm 110 Trinity Frames
items.description: Powerslide Combat Rocker 260mm 110 Trinity Frames. If you’re looking for a fast, agile, and reliable urban freeride triskate frame, the hunt is over. Say hello to the Combat Rocker 110 – 260 frame from POWERSLIDE. What may be the best urban freeride triskate frame on the market, the Combat Rocker 110 frame is designed to deliver unmatched urban freeride performance. Able to fit 3x110mm wheels, the frame gives you consistent speed while the trieskate setup improves agility. To further augment your individual skating style, the Combat frame incorporates HXG rocker spacers. These hexagon-shaped spacers can be easily adjusted to six different positions, allowing you to find the ideal rocker position for your individual skating style. Each wheel can be rockered individually, giving you virtually limitless options. Made of lightweight and super strong 6061 aircraft aluminum, the Combat triskate frame delivers excellent control and plenty of speed so you can bring your skating experience to a whole new level. The Powerslide Combat Rocker 260mm 110 Trinity Frames are engineered around the TRINITY 3-point mounting system. The TRINITY system brings your wheels as close to the boot as possible, giving you a low center of gravity, excellent stability, and improved control. For an unmatched urban freeride skating experience, give the Powerslide Combat Rocker 260mm 110 Trinity Frames a try.

items.title: Powerslide Tau 90 Carbon Urban Inline Skates
items.description: Powerslide Tau 90 Carbon Urban Inline Skates. Who says urban freestyle inline skates need to have 4 wheels? The POWERSLIDE Tau 90 is the first 3-wheel inline skate specifically developed for freestyle skating. The heart of the Tau is the POWERSLIDE Nexus rocker frame. The Nexus frame allows you to customize your set-up with a variety of rockering options which you can’t find on standard 4-wheel inline skates. The innovative frame incorporates the TRINITY 3-point mounting system and lets you ride on three 90mm wheels that are brought as close as possible to the boot. The rigid frame is light, and responsive, and delivers excellent power transfer in every stride and turn. The 3-wheel set-up is perfect for freestyle inline skating, providing numerous benefits. The POWERSLIDE Tau 90 gives superior agility and control, allows you to lift your heel and toe higher, makes it easier to balance on one wheel, and of course, you get plenty of speed. The POWERSLIDE Tau 90 is a comfortable and precise compression-molded carbon boot that’s heat-moldable. With an integrated MYFIT liner and sophisticated closure system that includes traditional lacing and ratchet buckles, your foot is kept securely in place, with unmatched control and confidence. Equipped with only the best as standard, the POWERSLIDE Tau 90 comes stock with 90mm / 88A Spinner wheels and Wicked ABEC 9 bearings that will give you a smooth, fast ride every time. Push your limits and find out what you’re capable of – the Tau 90 opens the door to new skating experiences.

The supportive shell and cuff construction along with the heel-locking 45-degree strap offer great support and a perfect heel lock. Our Elite aluminum frame featuring the patented TRINITY 3-point mounting system, fast rolling 90mm wheels and highly reliable Wicked bearings provide a new and unmatched skating experience.
