items.title: Just Swings 608 Ceramic Bearings (16 pack)
items.description: Just Swings 608 Ceramic Bearings. The Just Swings Ceramic bearings are premium inline skate bearings developed for competitive inline speed skating and demanding race conditions. Designed for skaters who prioritize rolling efficiency, precision, and durability, these high-performance skate bearings combine lightweight ceramic technology with specially hardened chrome steel raceways featuring a Ti coating for reduced friction and long-lasting performance. Each bearing uses 7 high-grade Si3N4 ceramic balls paired with a nylon cage reinforced with glass fiber for optimal stability at high speeds. The RZ single-sided rubber-coated steel shield helps protect the bearing from dirt and moisture while maintaining smooth, efficient rolling characteristics. Pre-lubricated with high-temperature oil, the Just Swings 608 Ceramic Bearings deliver a fast, consistent roll right out of the box, making them ideal for marathon skating, track racing, and intensive training sessions. At only 10.5g per bearing, the Just Swings 608 Ceramic Bearings offer a lightweight setup without compromising durability or control. Built for serious inline speed skaters, these inline skate bearings provide the responsive glide and reliable race-day performance demanded by competitive athletes.

items.title: SEBA Deluxe Orange 231mm 165 Inline Frames
items.description: SEBA Deluxe Orange 231mm 165 Inline Frames. The Seba Deluxe frame is considered one of the best frames on the market. It is stiffer, and lighter, and guarantees superior control, comfort, and outstanding power transfer. It is great for most demanding skating styles. The secret of the Deluxe frame is the tubular cross-braces. Cross braces are typically the weakest point in a frame, and the demands of slalom and freestyle skating can often lead them to crack. items.title: Powerslide Combat Rocker 290mm 90 Trinity Frames
items.description: Powerslide Combat Rocker 290mm 90 Trinity Frames. Fuel your creativity and discover what you’re really capable of on inline skates with the POWERSLIDE Combat Rocker 90 – 290 urban freeride frame. Constructed of lightweight and rigid 6061 aircraft aluminum, the Powerslide Combat Rocker 290mm 90 Trinity Frames deliver an excellent control and plenty of speed – exactly what urban freeride skaters need to perform precise tricks and slides. At the heart of the POWERSLIDE Combat Rocker frame are the revolutionary HXG rocker spacers. These hexagon-shaped spacers can be easily adjusted to six different positions, allowing you to find the ideal rocker position for your individual skating style. Each wheel can be rockered individually, giving you virtually limitless options. The Powerslide Combat Rocker 290mm 90 Trinity Frames are engineered around the TRINITY 3-point mounting system. The TRINITY system brings your wheels as close to the boot as possible, giving you a low center of gravity, excellent stability, and improved control. With a length of 290mm and able to fit 4x90mm wheels, this frame is long and stable, and thanks to the unique rockering options, you can still have the control and agility many urban freeride inline skaters are looking for. For an unmatched urban freeride inline skating experience, give the POWERSLIDE Combat Rocker 90 – 290 frame a try.

items.description: Powerslide MyFit Fitness Skating Socks are high-performance socks that have been specifically designed for fitness and recreational skating. items.title: SEBA TriX2 80 Inline Skates
items.description: SEBA TriX2 80 Inline Skates are designed for freestyle, fitness, and urban skating and are great mid-range boots for skaters who want better performance for a reasonable price. These skates are very fast, responsive, and durable. SEBA TriX2 80 Inline Skates feature a plastic shell, a unique triangle plastic cuff, and a built-in liner. This combination is providing good support with optimal front and back motion, close fit, and a great energy transfer.

items.title: FR SPIN Carbon Inline Skates
items.description: FR SPIN Carbon Inline Skates are a brand new concept model released by FR brand, specializing in high-performance and durability skates. The SPIN 80 boot is built using a mix of carbon fiber and fiberglass that provide outstanding power transfer and control while allowing to keep their cost relatively low. They also feature a mid-height cuff skate and are the perfect solution for those who are looking for a high-level, yet affordable urban skate.

items.title: SEBA TriX Carbon 80 Inline Skates
items.description: SEBA TriX Carbon 80 Inline Skates are a well-known Pro Model from Seba and the carbon version of a very successful Trix2 skate. These skates feature a carbon shell, a unique triangle plastic cuff, and a built-in liner. This combination provides excellent support with optimal front and back motion, close fit, and great energy transfer. SEBA TriX Carbon 80 Inline Skates work the best for skaters seeking a bit more freedom in the cuff area compared to the regular plastic cuff skates and is usually the go-to model for skaters used to speed or hockey skates.

items.title: SEBA TriX2 Women Inline Skates
items.description: SEBA TriX2 Women Inline Skates model features optimized for ladies’ feet boots paired with X2R Black Frames and Street Kings wheels! These are perfect skates for narrower feet and ankles. Because the SEBA team thinks that every foot should have a fitting skate, they have designed these models to suit the thinner shape of a woman’s foot. As well as being more comfortable, SEBA TriX2 Women Inline Skates have a more feminine design, with a V-cut liner, a thinner and girlier strap, and a pink touch in the wheels and laces. And because security and comfort are also a riding style, they have equipped these skates with a removable brake, so you can choose how you want to ride.

items.title: SEBA Deluxe Black 231mm 165 Inline Frames
items.description: SEBA Deluxe Black 231mm 165 Inline Frames. The Seba Deluxe frame is considered one of the best frames on the market. It is stiffer, and lighter, and guarantees superior control, comfort, and outstanding power transfer. It is great for most demanding skating styles. The secret of the Deluxe frame is the tubular cross-braces. Cross braces are typically the weakest point in a frame, and the demands of slalom and freestyle skating can often lead them to crack. In the Deluxe frame, after extrusion, the cross braces each have a hole drilled down the length to turn them into tubes. These tubes are much stronger than the standard cross brace, and provide the frame with excellent stiffness and durability. The short lengths available are ideal for slalom, freestyle, and dance skating disciplines.

items.title: NN Skates Ronin Rocker Trinity Frames
items.description: NN Skates Ronin Rocker Trinity Frames. With the perfect balance between agility and speed, the Trinity NN 100 is a top choice for intermediate to advanced skaters. The bigger wheels provide a smoother ride for skating longer distances, and the extra height allows for deeper edging for doing more advanced transitions and slides. The longer wheelbase provides better stability… whether it’s bombing hills, jumping at the skate park, or freeriding in an urban setting. The custom “V.m” rocker on NN Skates Ronin VM Rocker Trinity Frames provides extra maneuverability for practicing those technical moves on flat ground. Combining Powerslide’s proprietary Trinity mount with NN’s custom “V.m” rocker, these truly versatile NN Skates Ronin Rocker Trinity Frames will be your go-to choice for all occasions.

items.title: Kizer Type M II White UFS Aggressive Frames

We use our tried and tested “Fluid” material for the Type M and the frame comes as standard with our 8mm double steel axles. Strong, solid, and very long-lasting characterize this classic frame. items.title: Ennui ST Pirate 3 Pack Protection Set
items.description: Ennui ST Pirate 3 Pack Protection Set – Ride Bold. Ride Safe. For the young rebels carving their path through skateparks and street spots, the ENNUI Pirate Protective Gear Set is their ultimate shield. Designed for fearless kids diving into the world of aggressive skating, this set delivers serious protection with a style that stands out. Skull and crossbones included. The knee and elbow pads in the Ennui ST Pirate 3 Pack Protection Set are crafted for real impact, featuring thick anatomical padding that hugs the body naturally without restricting movement. The knee pads boast a smart open-back design with a winged closure system that makes putting them on fast and easy – even over clothing. Once they’re on, they stay in place thanks to a dual-strap combo: an elastic Velcro strap on top and a bottom strap with a secure clip buckle. The elbow pads are just as clever. Slip them on like a sleeve thanks to the soft sock construction, then lock them in with two adjustable elastic straps. Whether skating rails or throwing down in the bowl, these pads won’t budge. Ennui ST Pirate 3 Pack Protection Set’s wrist guards are built to do one job: keep young wrists safe when the ride gets rough. A rigid plastic splint on both the top and bottom provides all-around protection, helping prevent serious injuries. With the classic triple-strap closure system, they offer a snug fit that doesn’t slide around – letting kids stay focused on the fun, not the fall. From the ballistic nylon and PU leather shells to the signature skull branding, the Ennui ST Pirate 3 Pack Protection Set is equal parts protection and attitude. Available in XS, S, and M, it’s tailored for young shredders who want to push their limits – and look fearless doing it. Because when you’re building confidence on wheels, the right gear makes all the difference. These pads meet the EN 14120 European safety standard. Prefer a lighter look? The Pirate set is also available in a cheerful alternative: the colorful Ennui ST Smiley 3 Pack Protection Set – same protection, different vibe.

items.title: Transformer Figure Skating Inline Ice Blades
items.description: Transformer Figure Skating Inline Ice Blades allow you to convert your favorite rollerblades into recreational Figure Ice Skates in minutes and with a minimal investment. items.title: Powerslide Fothon Glow Slalom Cones

Thanks to the cuts on these cone walls, these cones will hold better in windy conditions and are designed to bounce off if the skate wheel rides over or a skater falls on them.

items.title: FR 310 248mm 3x110 165 Inline Frames

items.title: Powerslide 6mm Inline Skate Spacers
